out_items.name: Garbage and refuse properly disposed, facilities maintained

violations.title: Storage Areas/Receptacles, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: One of the side doors on the dumpster was damaged and had a hole in it. The other door appeared to have been replaced with another door, but that door is too small for the opening so it’s not capable of being closed. The condition of the doors makes it impossible to close the dumpster.
violations.corrective_action: Storage areas, enclosures, and receptacles for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be maintained in good repair. Please have the two doors repaired or replaced by the next inspection so that the dumpster can be properly closed at all times. The building supervisor stated he has already reported the damaged doors and is waiting for them or the dumpster to be replaced.
